reports.question: How do commuting tautological operators and Lefschetz lowering operators generate sl_n or Hamiltonian Lie algebra actions, and which parts of this mechanism are theorems for affine Grassmannians, braid/link homology and stable Higgs moduli, versus conjectures for explicit twisted P1 models?
reports.reading_scope: Read the complete official mathematical text in sections 1-5.5, all available HTML displays, both footnotes, references and publication/license metadata. The official 16-page PDF text was also consulted for Example 2.6 and the principal Jordan display. The image-only diagram in section 4.3 was not visually inspected: image retrieval failed, and PDF screenshot retrieval failed; no diagram-specific arrow claim is imported. Direct PDF downloading returned 403. Supplementary reading is partial and specified source by source below. In particular HMMS v2 section 8.5 through Remark 8.15 was read, not just the elliptic-locus result or Remark 8.1.
reports.coverage_status: 40 atomic knowledge pages (2Y01-2Y14 in base36 order), one narrative outline, one reference. Core linear algebra, Hamilton signs/centers, diagonal coinvariants, Satake consequences, braid fibers, y-ification, ordinary coprime stable Higgs action, and rank-two candidate-model calculations are covered. Global geometric proofs and the general twisted-P1 model are not claimed completed.

proof_scope.2Y01: Defines finite increasing filtered and split Lefschetz structures. Gives a one-dimensional example showing that the ungraded filtered operator need not be nilpotent.
proof_scope.2Y02: Complete primitive-chain decomposition proof using the Lefschetz isomorphisms, including directness, spanning, positive degrees and endpoints.
proof_scope.2Y03: Constructs f on each primitive chain, checks all sl2 relations and proves uniqueness by injectivity of a power of L; also proves functoriality for graded L-maps.
proof_scope.2Y04: Verifies the intrinsic kernel/image formula block by block, proves the weight and functoriality assertions. Uniqueness among all filtrations with the stated properties is cited, not reconstructed.
proof_scope.2Y05: Classical hard Lefschetz is cited for smooth complex projective X and an ample line bundle. Derives the two filtrations and proves the P2 example, correcting the increasing-filtration threshold to d-i.
proof_scope.2Y06: Complete two-chain graded example showing that chain centers, not just Jordan block sizes, determine the compensated filtration.
proof_scope.2Y07: Proves the differential combinations preserve (x^n), computes all three sl2 brackets including endpoints, and identifies the principal Jordan matrix without an ambiguous ellipsis row.
proof_scope.2Y08: Complete elementary highest-weight chain argument for the sl_n basis, including termination, independence by a commuting Casimir operator and dimension count. No use of an unproved decomposition into these chains.
proof_scope.2Y09: Verifies the diagonal tensor Lie action and the truncated differential operators. Explicitly distinguishes rho(N^2) from rho(N)^2.
proof_scope.2Y0A: Derives the Hamilton bracket from its action on x and y and fixes T_m0=-m x^(m-1) partial_y consistently with the report's section 2.4 convention.
proof_scope.2Y0B: Computes the adjoint chain coefficients and proves generation and closure of the Hamilton-degree-at-least-two subalgebra.
proof_scope.2Y0C: Derives the semidirect-product bracket from Leibniz and proves that the constant multiplication operator must be retained.
proof_scope.2Y0D: Defines the Poisson central extension and proves its dual-number quotient is the Hamilton-plus-multiplication semidirect product. Exhibits a nonzero Weyl commutator obstructing a literal tensor product after deleting all constants. Does not claim a replacement geometric action theorem for arbitrary curve labels.
proof_scope.2Y0E: Complete simplicity proof by minimal polynomial degree, the quadratic sl2 action on translations and polynomial integration. Deduces the finite-dimensional representation obstruction.
proof_scope.2Y0F: Defines the diagonal coinvariant ideal and proves finite dimensionality from x_i^n=y_i^n=0 in the quotient. Haiman's exact dimension is cited as a deep theorem.
proof_scope.2Y0G: Computes DC_2 and its three-dimensional sl2 representation with explicit signs and basis.
proof_scope.2Y0H: Proves preservation of the ideal by Hamilton fields vanishing at the origin and gives an explicit translation counterexample. No full-H2 action on finite-dimensional DC_n is asserted.
proof_scope.2Y0I: Defines the factorial pairing and graded dual; proves preservation and commutativity of the operators and checks n=2. Haiman's cyclic-generation theorem is cited, not proved via Hilbert-scheme geometry.
proof_scope.2Y0J: Proves the bounded lattice model is a closed projective subvariety of a finite Grassmannian by a tautological-bundle vanishing condition, and verifies the exhaustion embeddings.
proof_scope.2Y0K: Defines the tautological bundle and factorial normalization of p_i, proves stabilization by an exact sequence, and fixes the ample sign. Vanishing p_i for i>=n is cited from Proposition 3.1.
proof_scope.2Y0L: States the formula for projective f:X->Y with X smooth using absolute perverse indices. Derives it from the cited decomposition and hard Lefschetz theorems by a chain-degree calculation; distinguishes base ample from relatively ample classes.
proof_scope.2Y0M: Cites geometric Satake and compatibility with tautological classes for smooth connected complex projective, positive-loop-equivariant X->Gr_GL_n. Does not claim the full tensor equivalence is proved locally or that arbitrary splittings suffice.
proof_scope.2Y0N: Gives an explicit signed Schubert/wedge identification, relying on classical Pieri and Satake, and checks the weights and the Gr(2,4) invariant vector directly.
proof_scope.2Y0O: Defines the matrix variety and directly verifies the adjacent braid coordinate change and invertibility. No Markov invariance of this unquotiented variety is inferred.
proof_scope.2Y0P: Derives the torus action ratio with an explicit right-shift convention. States all genericity conditions and cites freeness, affineness and Zariski local triviality of the quotient.
proof_scope.2Y0Q: Complete matrix computation of X_sigma1^3=C* x A1 and each fixed diagonal quotient Y=A1.
proof_scope.2Y0R: Cites the compactly supported curious-hard-Lefschetz theorem with its precise middle weight ell-n-c+2 and genericity assumptions. Explains compact supports, even weights and the A1 check. Full toric-stratification proof is external.
proof_scope.2Y0S: Defines Hochschild homology through linked Tor, distinguishes the termwise Hochschild construction from total derived Tor, and checks cancellation of the y-curvature after component identification. Full chain-level construction and Markov invariance are cited.
proof_scope.2Y0T: States GHM's commuting F_k relations and the exact three-graded F_2 isomorphism. Checks the unknot model and Hamilton sign. The general link homology theorem is cited; finite-dimensional primitive decomposition is not applied blindly to an infinite module.
proof_scope.2Y0U: Labels the general full-H2/H2>=2 extension as a conjecture, separately states the proved (n,n+1) reduced-torus-knot case from GM2026, and distinguishes the report's (n,2n+1) conjecture.
proof_scope.2Y0V: Complete algebraic eigen-operator criterion for a generator-weight filtration, with an explicit truncated-polynomial example. It is an exact-commutator model, not a claim that all raw geometric tautological classes are eigenvectors.
proof_scope.2Y0W: States HMMS Corollary 7.5 on the reduced-irreducible spectral-curve locus, with smooth projective C, simple effective D, fixed rank/degree and tautological cohomology. Separates the larger W_S caveat of Remark 8.1 from the ordinary stable H2 action of Remark 8.15.
proof_scope.2Y0X: Defines the P1 twisting and slope stability, proves the rank-one coarse moduli calculation A^k, and records that the report's conjecture omits an explicit degree parameter rather than inventing degree-independence.
proof_scope.2Y0Y: Fixes the report's second definition of M_nk for k>=1, defines all operator and product conventions, and proves k=1 and n=1 boundary cases. Does not use the unproved equivalence with the first presentation.
proof_scope.2Y0Z: Defines the signed shuffle quotient, proves formal associativity and the exchange sign, and gives the rank-one pair example. Closure in M_(a+b),k for general rank is cited from the report, not proved by formal shuffle combinatorics alone.
proof_scope.2Y10: Keeps Conjectures 5.8,5.10,5.11 conjectural. Proves only the conditional annihilator-ideal construction once descent and cyclicity hold. Does not treat the primitive quotient as an a priori cohomology ring.
proof_scope.2Y11: Complete rank-two Laurent criterion, reducing all anti-invariant operators to a^(k-1-u)(2 partial_b)^u, proving necessity, sufficiency, parity and absence of cross-term cancellation.
proof_scope.2Y12: Proves that rank-two shuffle products span exactly the polynomial parity sector, gives a free basis for the primitive quotient, computes Hilbert series and the necessary q^-1 overall shift. Geometric identification remains conjectural.
proof_scope.2Y13: States the established full-H2 action on all H*(M_r,d)[x,y] for ordinary coprime stable Higgs bundles on a smooth complex projective curve of genus>=2, citing HMMS Remark 8.15. Explains the flag/anti-invariant descent, and proves only the immediate splitting consequence of AB=+-r!, not the geometric identities or Hecke preservation themselves.
proof_scope.2Y14: Constructs the unshifted positive Rouquier complex from C_i=R tensor_(R^si) R, proves multiplication is well-defined and d^2=0 with an explicit tensor-square sign check. Braid homotopy invariance and graded normalization remain cited inputs.

remaining_branches: The category of filtered Lefschetz structures, strictness/abelianness in Proposition 2.4 and uniqueness proof for the canonical nilpotent filtration are not independently expanded.
General geometric Satake tensor equivalence, decomposition theorem and Vasserot compatibility are cited through the official report; their original proofs were not independently read.
General character-variety stratification, parabolic monodromy hypotheses beyond the fixed braid-fiber theorem, and the full curious-hard-Lefschetz proof are not reconstructed.

General negative Rouquier complexes, all three-grading normalization shifts, Markov invariance and the GHM Lefschetz proof remain primary-source inputs. The new Rouquier atom is deliberately the positive unshifted model.

The full HMMS Hecke algebra construction and geometric descent proofs remain cited. Final ordinary coprime H2 action is nevertheless included via Remark 8.15, not incorrectly left as an elliptic-only result.

Main Proposition 5.9's zero-index conventions and central-extension normalization require a separate source clarification before importing its full operator family. No inverse derivative is defined here.

Equivalence of the two definitions of M_nk, general-rank shuffle closure, Conjectures 5.8/5.10/5.11 and the degree parameter omitted by the report are not resolved. Rank-two algebra is proved independently without asserting the geometric conjecture.
Official image-only diagram and final rendered site pages remain visually unchecked in this writer task; parent owns global compilation, normalization and integration.
normalization_notes: Use H_f=f_y partial_x-f_x partial_y throughout, matching main section 2.4; GM2026 writes the opposite Hamilton convention.
Use p_i=i! ch_i for tautological power sums; the ample Pluecker class is -p_1 for the subbundle convention.
Absolute Q_i perverse truncation and the site's P_k=Q_(k+dimY) normalization are kept separate; canonical nilpotent F decreases by two under N.
H2, its origin-preserving H2>=2 subalgebra, the Poisson algebra with central constants and the Hamilton-plus-multiplication semidirect product are different objects.
Full H2 on stable ordinary Higgs cohomology requires adjoining x,y. The finite-dimensional diagonal coinvariant and reduced knot actions use H2>=2.
Main M_nk rank-two Hilbert numerator has an additional q^-1 shift relative to the inverted formula (5.2).

reports.speaker: Yongchang Zhu
reports.title: Representations and Automorphic Forms of Loop Groups
reports.outline_title: 回路群的表示与自守形式：从中心扩张到 theta 提升
reports.version: Official ICM2026 Volume 4 proceedings HTML, online 2026-07-13, read 2026-10-19; no arXiv version substituted for the report.
reports.license: CC BY 4.0; copyright 2026 International Mathematical Union; published by SIAM.
reports.question: Which parts of automorphic representation theory survive for explicitly specified polynomial, formal and adelic loop groups, and how do central extension, rotation, support completion and topological function spaces make Eisenstein series, Hecke functions and theta lifting well-defined?
reports.reading_scope: Read the complete official mathematical text of Sections 1-4, equations, theorem statements, references 1-56, and publication/license metadata, not only the abstract. Section 4 has no numbered subsections. Supplemental primary papers were read only in the versioned ranges recorded below. No local byte-identical source archive or hash is claimed.
reports.coverage_status: 39 atomic knowledge pages 2Z01-2Z13, one narrative outline 2Z00 and one reference. Main report branches covered, with exact local Hecke formulas deliberately restricted to the simply-laced hypotheses of the primary sources.

proof_scope.2Z01: Defines polynomial/formal/smooth loop versions; gives a strict-inclusion example and proves the non-local-compactness obstruction for the explicitly stated t-adic topology over an infinite discrete coefficient field.
proof_scope.2Z02: Proves the degree operator is a derivation of the existing residue central extension; group-level Tits extension is cited.
proof_scope.2Z03: Computes all real/imaginary root spaces and multiplicities from the adjoint brackets, using finite-dimensional root decomposition as prerequisite.
proof_scope.2Z04: General Tits-cone description is cited; rank-one reflection formulas and all three level cases are proved directly.
proof_scope.2Z05: Defines the adelic integrality condition and proves noncontainment in both directions with explicit prime-indexed examples.
proof_scope.2Z06: Proves representative-independence and rational left-invariance by reindexing absolutely convergent sums. Inducing character is on T(A)/T(F), unramified and trivially extended over rotation. Gives a counterexample showing unramified alone is insufficient.
proof_scope.2Z07: States Garland real arithmetic and Liu number-field convergence separately; almost-everywhere, constant-term and uniform convergence are not conflated. Analytic proofs external.
proof_scope.2Z08: Cites the complete constant-term formula with a matched Weyl inversion convention. Derives the Q Euler factors from the definition of completed zeta; general discriminant normalization is not expanded.
proof_scope.2Z09: Complete shell-integral proof, sharp local absolute-convergence half-plane and exact q=3,s=2 calculation.
proof_scope.2Z0A: Cites Liu Theorem 4.9 in a convergence domain; single inducing term is not zero. Opposite-parabolic L-function calculations and regularization are not promoted to established analytic formulas.
proof_scope.2Z0B: Proves double-invariance, unit and associativity conditional on explicit finite-fiber/support assumptions. Affine finiteness is cited.
proof_scope.2Z0C: Proves coefficientwise finiteness, multiplication closure and associativity for downward-supported completions; distinguishes larger auxiliary completion from the Tits-supported Satake ring.
proof_scope.2Z0D: Cites Cartan decomposition, finite convolution and Satake isomorphism under split simple simply-connected untwisted simply-laced assumptions, retaining the zero-level boundary.
proof_scope.2Z0E: Cites affine Macdonald and Macdonald-Cherednik identities. Computes rank-one correction and inverse coefficients through degree two exactly.
proof_scope.2Z0F: States complete Bernstein presentation and positive-level subalgebra; proves the apparent fraction is finite and checks the quadratic normalization. Identification with convolution is cited.
proof_scope.2Z0G: Defines the counting Whittaker function and explicitly rescales by q^(-rho.lambda); cites finiteness and Casselman-Shalika with all root multiplicities. No uniqueness theorem assumed.
proof_scope.2Z0H: Complete proof that residue pairing is well-defined, alternating and nondegenerate; checks degree sum -1.
proof_scope.2Z0I: Complete Lagrange-polarization proof and direct-sum/product duality calculation.
proof_scope.2Z0J: Complete Heisenberg group law, associativity, inverse, commutator and center calculations.
proof_scope.2Z0K: Complete verification of the Schrodinger half-phase representation law and Weyl commutation relation.
proof_scope.2Z0L: Proves finite rank of the mixing block from a common pole bound; computes the diagonal rank-one example.
proof_scope.2Z0M: Proves independence of the integration lift and the algebraic cocycle-to-central-extension step. Existence, convergence and projective composition of general Weil intertwiners are cited; no K2/tame-symbol formula imported.
proof_scope.2Z0N: Proves formal inverse derivative and residue change of variables, including an explicit failed substitution without the differential factor.
proof_scope.2Z0O: Defines slice Schwartz functions and proves completeness for the discrete-quotient linear topology via compatible restriction systems.
proof_scope.2Z0P: Defines the restricted elementary and positive-rotation classes; computes the two halves of the rotated Gaussian using functions and one-forms. Global representation construction is cited.
proof_scope.2Z0Q: Cites absolute theta convergence and rational symplectic invariance; proves rational Heisenberg invariance and constructs a divergent unrotated slice-Schwartz example.
proof_scope.2Z0R: Proves the tensor symplectic form and commuting actions; identifies the diagonal sign kernel. Positive-loop splitting and central z-to-z^m lift are cited.
proof_scope.2Z0S: Defines theta lifting and distinguishes cusp-weighted convergence from the unweighted dimension/rotation criterion. Reduction theory, growth and quotient measure inputs are cited.
proof_scope.2Z0T: States the finite Fourier support function class, with its discrete character interpretation and standard unramified-vector example. It is not replaced by arbitrary Schwartz vectors.
proof_scope.2Z0U: Cites Liu-Zhu Theorem 3.3 with m>6n+2, the anisotropic-or-inequality alternative and finite Fourier support. No regularized extension is asserted.
proof_scope.2Z0V: Cites the full Rallis constant-term formula and identifies the finite-dimensional residual space and Levi factors; general orbit proof external.
proof_scope.2Z0W: Proves cusp vanishing below first occurrence conditional on Rallis and the definition of first occurrence. Nonvanishing and modified/full-lift distinction are explicit.
proof_scope.2Z0X: Complete convergence, growth and explicit logarithmic-tail estimate for the modal product; does not claim to prove full theta integral convergence.
proof_scope.2Z0Y: Defines linear-topological fields with uniform negative-mode image control and proves the continuous-dual truncation statement.
proof_scope.2Z0Z: Complete proof of convergence, continuity and uniform negative-tail property of every nth field product; the finite-head split is chosen independently of the outgoing negative mode.

remaining_branches: General Tits group construction, group-level universality and detailed K2/tame-symbol cocycle formulas are not developed. In particular no exact K2 formula has been validated by the independent reviewer.

Garland real arithmetic convergence, GMP entirety and general-number-field sharp uniform convergence require their original analytic proofs; the latter is conjectural in the cited Liu v2 range discussion.
Opposite-parabolic Eisenstein regularization and associated higher L-functions remain explicitly distinguished from convergent Euler-integral representations.
Non-simply-laced and twisted affine Hecke/Whittaker formulas are not extrapolated from the simply-laced product used here.
Full BKP finite-fiber, Satake and Macdonald proofs and Patnaik Casselman-Shalika proof are external inputs.
Global theta convergence, quotient measure/reduction theory and full Siegel-Weil orbit analysis are cited; no regularized formula outside the stated range is supplied.
General Rallis proof in LZ Section 5, classical first-occurrence existence/irreducibility and detailed nonvanishing examples are not reconstructed.

Vertex-algebra reconstruction, general-rank free-field structure, general real loop representation classification and the report's explicitly unpublished refined K-type results are not claimed as proved.

The report's direct sum is valid as a C-vector-space sum when V consists of constant vectors. It must not be read as a direct sum of O-submodules: O times t^(-1)V intersects O^n. The note writes O^n+t^(-1)V to avoid that mistaken module-level reading.
